summary: A Dupont Street dental studio appears to lose new patients to a default page title, jumbled opening hours and no quick way to message.

findings.problem: The page title appears as Home | My Site and the header appears to read My Site, which are default Wix names.
findings.cost: Google and browser tabs show My Site instead of your studio, so searchers do not see who you are.
findings.fix: A title and header with the studio name and area.

findings.problem: The opening hours appear jumbled, with times listed after Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday that do not line up with the days.
findings.cost: A patient checking hours before booking may give up or turn up at the wrong time.

findings.problem: No online price guide, reviews or text option appear next to Book Now.
findings.cost: Patients compare studios on price and proof, and many prefer to text a question first.
findings.fix: Reviews, price ranges and a one tap text button.
